test_read_csv_with_index_and_dates: test read_csv with index_col and parse_dates to parse a CSV file into a DataFrame with a datetime index
test_read_csv_with_thousands_separator: test read_csv with thousands separator to correctly parse numbers containing comma separators
test_read_csv_with_nrows: test read_csv with nrows parameter to limit the number of data rows read from a CSV file
test_read_csv_with_unnamed_columns: test read_csv to handle CSV data with unnamed trailing columns and auto-generate column names
